quoting_config.h_min_ticks_meaning: join the touch (0 ticks behind) before the skew and inventory terms
quoting_config.inv_skew_ticks: TO_CONFIRM (ticks per qty of inventory; v1 had no explicit inventory skew)
quoting_config.alpha_weight: TO_CONFIRM: skew_ticks = round(alpha_weight * er * mid / tick); at weight 1.0 er*mid is ~0.14 cents (< half a tick) so the skew rounds to 0. Fix a weight (or an er-to-ticks scale) from the in-sample er distribution BEFORE registration so the median |skew| is >= 1 tick, and record it here

decisions: As v1: 1 s grid 09:31:00-15:59:00 New York on continuous-trading rows; skewed cells use the alpha fitted on sessions strictly before the test session (frozen-parameter scoring); control uses er = 0 on all 3 symbols.
walk_forward: As v1: session 1 warm-up only; 6 test sessions; previous session's calibration per symbol.

latency_ASSUMED.note: ASSUMED, not measured: ITCH carries no receive stamp.

statistic: As v1 (session-clustered mean net USD per session, Student-t CI with sessions-1 df, full P&L decomposition), plus ticks_behind_touch_{mean,median,max} and frac_decisions_skew_changed_quote per cell.
validity_gate: Before any P&L is read: a skewed cell is VALID only if frac_decisions_skew_changed_quote >= TO_CONFIRM (proposed 0.10); an invalid cell reports 'skew inert' and gets no verdict.
verdict_rule: As v1: quoting edge EXISTS for a cell iff mean net USD/session > 0 AND its Bonferroni CI over the 4 cells excludes 0 AND >= 4 of 6 test sessions have quote fills. Skew HELPS iff mean(skewed - control) > 0 with its Bonferroni CI excluding 0 (testable only on VALID cells). In-sample: EXISTS reads 'worth an out-of-sample test'. No tuning after results; no sweep.
